A.title: Intracorporeal vs. extracorporeal open and closed knot tying techniques in laparoscopy: A randomized, controlled study
A.table: Table 1. Comparison of different knot tying techniques by run time, knot strength and knot-spread ability.
A.why_table: Twelve comparisons from mixed-effects models (log-linear, linear and logistic), with confidence intervals and p-values. The Methods name the models but not their exact form, so there are real analyst choices to make.

B.title: Equations for estimating binary mixture toxicity: Methyl-2-chloroacetoacetate-containing combinations
B.table: Table 2. Summary statistics for methyl-2-chloroacetoacetate (M2CA) tested alone (n = 31).
B.why_table: Each of the 93 values behind it comes from fitting an asymmetric five-parameter dose-response curve to raw bioassay data, then summarising across 31 tests. A pure test of whether the curve-fitting method is written down well enough.
